Step Range: 0-20
The Oracle: The 1st Virginia Regiment saw action at the Battle of Great Bridge, leading to the departure of Lord Dunmore.
Evidence: The battle occurred on December 9, 1775, with the 1st Virginia Regiment participating, causing Lord Dunmore to evacuate Virginia.
